dct_title_s: Flood impact assessment in East Sao Vicente Municipality, Cabo Verde as of 14 August 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20250812CPV** This map illustrates satellite-detected mudflow extent in East Sao Vicente Municipality, Cabo Verde as observed from Pleiades very high-resolution satellite image acquired on 14 August 2025 at 11:43 local time (12:43 UTC). Within the analyzed area of approximately 35 km², about 3 km² of land appears to be affected by flood.  UNOSAT identified around 1,000 affected/potentially affected buildings and approximately 15 km of affected roads.
